title: [FEATURE] Add durable identifiers to messages
body:
### SDK Language

Python

### Problem Statement

Message extraction by MemoryStores currently needs its own deduping solution with identifiers, because messages do not carry their own durable ids. The only tracking we can currently provide is in-session hwm sequence numbers, which don't scale beyond a session. This poses problems for session restore.

### Proposed Solution

Add durable IDs to each message

### Use Case

MemoryStores can use these durable IDs together with a SessionID to identify uniqueness and take care of deduplication.

### Alternatives Solutions

_No response_

### Additional Context

_No response_
